scenes.tts: A smooth slope of signal should give a blur. Yet the domains have sharp borders. Why?
scenes.visual: Title card: Drawing the Lines. A smooth gold slope beside a wall cut into crisp stripes. Box 4 is highlighted.
scenes.narration: A smooth slope of signal should give a blur. Yet the domains have sharp borders. Why?

scenes.tts: Picture a cell whose output simply rises with the signal, the gentle curve of simple binding.
scenes.visual: A saturating response curve drawn on a log concentration axis, so it looks S-shaped. Labels: Hill coefficient 1, graded; log concentration.
scenes.narration: Picture a cell whose output simply rises with the signal, the gentle curve of simple binding.

scenes.tts: Going from ten to ninety percent output then takes an eighty-one-fold change in concentration.
scenes.caption: Going from 10 to 90 percent output then takes an 81-fold change in concentration.
scenes.visual: On screen: 10% to 90% of the response needs an 81-fold change in concentration: 9-fold to half, then 9-fold more.
scenes.narration: Going from 10 to 90 percent output then takes an 81-fold change in concentration.

scenes.tts: On an illustrative slope, that change spans about eighteen cells. Eighteen cells of in-between answers is a blur.
scenes.visual: The wall with a smeared band about 18 cells tall. On screen: illustrative slope, decay length 20 micrometres, cells 5 micrometres wide.
scenes.narration: On an illustrative slope, that change spans about eighteen cells. Eighteen cells of in-between answers is a blur.

scenes.tts: In this simple model, a steeper, switch-like response narrows the blur to one or two cells.
scenes.visual: A table builds, titled: 10 to 90% expression width, illustrative Hill model. Hill 1, about 18 cells; Hill 2, about 9; Hill 4, about 4; Hill 8, about 2. The smeared band narrows to a crisp line; every cell stays in place.
scenes.narration: In this simple model, a steeper, switch-like response narrows the blur to one or two cells.

scenes.tts: The cells are all still there. Fewer of them give in-between answers.
scenes.visual: The same row of cells, all present; only a few at the line show an in-between colour.
scenes.narration: The cells are all still there. Fewer of them give in-between answers.

scenes.tts: The domains get their switch from the factors themselves. Factors on either side of a border repress each other.
scenes.visual: Two factor names on either side of a border, each with a blunt arrow pointing at the other.
scenes.narration: The domains get their switch from the factors themselves. Factors on either side of a border repress each other.

scenes.tts: This was tested by electroporation. D N A is pushed into cells on one side of the tube. The other side is the control.
scenes.caption: This was tested by electroporation. DNA is pushed into cells on one side of the tube. The other side is the control.
scenes.visual: Electrodes on either side of a chick neural tube; one half glows green, the other is labelled control.
scenes.narration: This was tested by electroporation. DNA is pushed into cells on one side of the tube. The other side is the control.

scenes.tts: James Briscoe and colleagues showed that Pax six and N K X two point two repress each other.
scenes.caption: James Briscoe and colleagues showed that Pax6 and Nkx2.2 repress each other.
scenes.visual: Pax6 and Nkx2.2 as two blunt arrows blocking each other.
scenes.narration: James Briscoe and colleagues showed that Pax6 and Nkx2.2 repress each other.

scenes.tts: They meet at the border between p M N and p three.
scenes.caption: They meet at the border between pMN and p3.
scenes.visual: The transverse neural tube map, dorsal up: notochord below, floor plate at the bottom, ventricular zone around the central canal, roof plate at the top, epidermis over it. The pMN to p3 border is highlighted.
scenes.narration: They meet at the border between pMN and p3.

scenes.tts: Novitch, Chen and Jessell found the same for I R X three and Olig two.
scenes.caption: Novitch, Chen and Jessell found the same for Irx3 and Olig2.
scenes.visual: Credit: Novitch, Chen and Jessell, 2001. Irx3 and Olig2 as blocking arrows at the upper pMN border, the pairs from chapter 3.
scenes.narration: Novitch, Chen and Jessell found the same for Irx3 and Olig2.

scenes.tts: Predict. Force N K X two point two on in the motor neuron domain. What happens to those cells?
scenes.caption: Predict. Force Nkx2.2 on in the motor neuron domain. What happens to those cells?
scenes.visual: Half the tube glows as Nkx2.2 is forced into pMN. Question on screen: what happens?
scenes.narration: Predict. Force Nkx2.2 on in the motor neuron domain. What happens to those cells?

scenes.tts: Motor neurons are suppressed on that side. The cells make V three neurons, the fate of the domain below.
scenes.caption: Motor neurons are suppressed on that side. The cells make V3 neurons, the fate of the domain below.
scenes.visual: On the glowing side, motor neurons vanish and V3 neurons appear. The control side is unchanged.
scenes.narration: Motor neurons are suppressed on that side. The cells make V3 neurons, the fate of the domain below.

scenes.tts: One factor in the wrong place moved the line for those cells. Nothing was done to the Shh source.
scenes.visual: The notochord and floor plate are drawn unchanged on both sides. Label: no imposed change to the Shh source. Only the line has moved on the electroporated side.
scenes.narration: One factor in the wrong place moved the line for those cells. Nothing was done to the Shh source.

scenes.tts: Two factors that repress each other can form a switch with two stable states.
scenes.visual: A ball on a landscape with two valleys. Label: bistable switch.
scenes.narration: Two factors that repress each other can form a switch with two stable states.

scenes.tts: In simple models, they do so only when the repression is strong and cooperative. A weak loop makes no switch.
scenes.visual: The two valleys merge into one when the arrows are drawn thin. Label: weak loop, no switch.
scenes.narration: In simple models, they do so only when the repression is strong and cooperative. A weak loop makes no switch.

scenes.tts: In a strongly cross-repressive circuit, a cell near a border cannot hold both factors for long. It falls to one side, and the loop helps hold it there.
scenes.visual: A border cell rolls into one valley and stays.
scenes.narration: In a strongly cross-repressive circuit, a cell near a border cannot hold both factors for long. It falls to one side, and the loop helps hold it there.

scenes.tts: That gives the network some memory. In two thousand twelve, Briscoe's group tested it in mouse embryos in culture.
scenes.caption: That gives the network some memory. In 2012, Briscoe's group tested it in mouse embryos in culture.
scenes.visual: Credit: Balaskas, Ribes, Briscoe and colleagues, 2012. A cultured mouse embryo.
scenes.narration: That gives the network some memory. In 2012, Briscoe's group tested it in mouse embryos in culture.

scenes.tts: A short pulse of a drug that activates Smoothened left the borders close to normal. Continuous treatment shifted them.
scenes.visual: A brief spike of drug on a timeline; the borders stay put. Then a long bar of drug; the borders move.
scenes.narration: A short pulse of a drug that activates Smoothened left the borders close to normal. Continuous treatment shifted them.

scenes.tts: There is a limit here. Sharp is not the same as accurate.
scenes.visual: Limit card: sharp is not the same as accurate.
scenes.narration: There is a limit here. Sharp is not the same as accurate.

scenes.tts: A large or lasting misreading can tip a cell to the wrong side. The switch may then hold the error.
scenes.visual: A border with brief blips that fade away, and one cell with a long misreading that rolls into the wrong valley. Label: large or lasting error.
scenes.narration: A large or lasting misreading can tip a cell to the wrong side. The switch may then hold the error.

scenes.tts: Placing borders accurately is a separate problem. In models, reading over time, and reading two opposing slopes, can help.
scenes.visual: The ragged border smooths as a clock runs and a second, opposing slope appears from above. Label: possible benefit in a model.
scenes.narration: Placing borders accurately is a separate problem. In models, reading over time, and reading two opposing slopes, can help.

scenes.tts: The takeaway: the slope sets roughly where each line falls. Pairs of repressors make each line sharp, and help hold it.
scenes.visual: The transverse neural tube map, dorsal up: notochord below, floor plate at the bottom, ventricular zone around the central canal, roof plate at the top, epidermis over it. Box 4 fills with: pairs of repressors make the lines sharp and help hold them. Takeaway on screen.
scenes.narration: The takeaway: the slope sets roughly where each line falls. Pairs of repressors make each line sharp, and help hold it.
